cases.name: keeps a new workspace whole, and lists it
saves a change-log entry and gives it back
keeps a cycle’s check-in rhythm whole: no set rhythm, every week from a day, and back
saves a goal one version on, and refuses a save based on the version before it as stale
never lets a save to one workspace change another’s records
keeps a module’s records whole, saves them with a commit, and removes and restores them with what they point to
brings back what Undo restores, as loaded, and it stays back after the next load
puts back what an import deleted, stopped or marked as left when the import is undone, and it stays back
issues an AI assistant token once, never keeps its secret, and revokes it
deletes a workspace and everything in it
narrows a load to a window: check-ins of cycles that overlap it, and entries from its start plus the anchors of any age
keeps the newest two cycles’ check-ins however far back the window starts (the year in use never falls out)
pages back through the change log newest first, with no skips or repeats, and narrows it to a goal
loads the whole workspace when no window is asked for, and says nothing was left out
